Privacy.title: Privacy Policy (Datenschutzerklärung)
Privacy.intro: Welcome to our Privacy Policy. Your privacy is critically important to us.
Privacy.p1: We process personal data only when strictly necessary. The primary function of this service (converting CSV/Excel files to E-Invoices) happens entirely in memory.
Privacy.p2: Files uploaded to our servers are processed immediately and held only in RAM. They are never stored on any persistent storage (disk) and are completely discarded after the request completes. We do not keep logs of the generated invoices or your client data.
Privacy.p3: We use a strictly necessary local storage entry to remember your cookie consent preferences. We do not use any third-party analytics, marketing, or tracking cookies.
Privacy.p4: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, or erase your personal data. However, since we do not store any of your invoice data, there is no data to access, rectify, or erase on our servers after your session ends.
Privacy.p5: For privacy inquiries, please contact us at privacy@einvoice-saas.example.com.

AVV.title: Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
AVV.intro: This Data Processing Agreement (DPA) according to Art. 28 GDPR is concluded between the user (Data Controller) and us (Data Processor) upon registration on our platform.
AVV.p1: The Processor provides services in the field of e-invoice creation for the Controller. Personal data is processed in this context. The application basically works 'Memory-Only'. No invoice XMLs or invoice metadata (such as buyer addresses) are permanently stored on our servers. All generated invoices are immediately deleted from volatile memory after generation.
AVV.li1: Contact details (Name, Address, Email) of the invoice recipient.
AVV.li2: Company data of the invoice recipient (VAT ID, Address).
AVV.p3: Processing takes place exclusively at the moment of XML/PDF file generation ('On-the-fly'). The duration of data processing is limited to a few milliseconds to seconds. After the Controller downloads the file, the data is irrevocably deleted.
AVV.p4: We ensure that all servers (Location: Germany) are operated according to current security standards (SSL encryption). Since there is no persistent storage of invoice data, the risk of a data breach is systematically reduced to an absolute minimum.
AVV.p5: By creating an account on our platform (Free or Business), the Controller automatically agrees to this DPA.
